content.thinking:
I'm checking the order confirmation OA26811412, which has two lines for the same material at 130,000 units each but with different dates, and it ties back to customer order 4500318748 from 2026-09-29. The duplicate lines might be a split delivery, and there's no PO quantity visible to compare against. I'm settling on quantity_confirmed for the "Qty" field, since it appears on a confirmation.

I'm settling on date_confirmed for the confirmed dates, with unit price 9.8 and the two dates 2026-12-04 and 2026-12-14 as line values. The order date 2026-09-29 belongs at document level, so I'll leave it off the lines, and since no document date is stated, I'm marking that as null.

verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26811412 from Hwaseong Memory to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318748 (dated 2026-09-29). It has two lines for the same material CMP-GAM-001 (Game Card 128 GB – Grand Heist 6). Each line is 130,000 pcs at 9.8 USD, confirmed for 2026-12-04 and 2026-12-14 respectively. Terms are FOB Busan and NET45. There are no handwritten changes or stamps.
red_flags: The same material appears on two lines with identical quantity and price but different confirmed dates (2026-12-04 and 2026-12-14). This is a split delivery, totalling 260,000 pcs. The buyer should check it against the PO quantity, because the PO is not shown here.
The document does not state the unit of measure, a document date, or a total value.
